name: Gredler
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gredler in Zell am Ziller**

Discover the **Gredler** – a legendary ski area in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Whether you're a seasoned skier or a first-timer, this family-friendly resort offers breathtaking slopes for every level.

**Skiing & Snowboarding**
With over **100 km of perfectly groomed runs**, **Gredler** is a paradise for winter sports enthusiasts. Enjoy the thrilling **black runs** of the **Gredlerkopf** or take it easy on the gentle **blue and red routes** through the picturesque **Zillertal**. The **snowpark** is a hotspot for freestylers, while the **night skiing** on selected slopes keeps the fun going after dark.

**After-Ski & Relaxation**
Wind down with a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** or a warm **Glühwein** at one of the cozy **Hütten** (mountain huts). The **Gredlerbahn** (cable car) offers stunning views of the valley—perfect for a relaxing break.

**Summer Adventures**
When the snow melts, **Gredler** transforms into a hiking and mountain biking paradise. Explore the **Zillertal’s** lush trails, take the **Gampenbahn** to the summit, or enjoy panoramic views from the **Gredlerkopf**.

**Accommodation & Dining**
Stay in charming **Zell am Ziller** or nearby villages like **Fieberbrunn** and **Hippach**. From rustic **Gasthöfe** to modern hotels, there’s something for every taste. Don’t miss trying local specialties like **Tiroler Gröstl** or **Käsekrainer** at traditional **Biergärten**.

**How to Get There**
Reach **Zell am Ziller** by car via the **Innsbruck-Zell am Ziller** highway (A12) or take the **Zillertalbahn** from **Innsbruck** for a scenic train ride.

Plan your next adventure in **Tirol**—where every season brings new excitement to **Gredler**!
